evidence.detail: R48 RSApplet constructs rs/D with only the applet parent reference and immediately registers it through the applet host Component.addComponentListener path.
rs/D extends ComponentAdapter and overrides only componentMoved(ComponentEvent); it owns no resize/show/hide behavior or unrelated state.

componentMoved compares System.currentTimeMillis against the client-global previous-move timestamp, ignores events within 100 ms, and otherwise flips one client move/redraw marker boolean and records the new timestamp.
The class is a tiny host-component move listener only. The meaning of the downstream client marker is intentionally not broadened beyond the exact move-event signal.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 helper name; no standalone historical source identifier is claimed.
